article_title: Two rescued after Nairobi building collapse with five still missing

tasks.prompt: What is the main news in the article?
options: Two people were rescued after a Nairobi building collapsed, while five remained missing.
A finished Nairobi shopping centre was closed for repairs.
All construction workers in Nairobi began a strike.
Kenya opened a new emergency hospital in Eastleigh.
tasks.correct_answer: Two people were rescued after a Nairobi building collapsed, while five remained missing.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתמקדת בחילוץ שני אנשים בחיים מהריסות בניין בניירובי, בזמן שהחיפוש אחר חמישה נעדרים נמשך.

tasks.prompt: Where were the people still missing believed to have been?
options: On the roof
In shops at the base of the building
In a nearby police station
Inside construction vehicles
tasks.correct_answer: In shops at the base of the building
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה, הנעדרים היו כנראה בחנויות שפעלו בקומות התחתונות של הבניין.

tasks.prompt: How many of the 67 construction workers escaped unharmed?
options: Five
Eleven
Sixty-six
All sixty-seven
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בכיר במשרד הפנים מסר כי 66 מתוך 67 עובדי הבנייה יצאו ללא פגע, והעובד הנוסף נפצע פציעה שאינה מסכנת חיים.

tasks.prompt: Who were police searching for after the collapse?
options: Two rescued shoppers
The Nairobi governor and a police officer
The architect and every shop worker
The building's owner and the site contractor
tasks.correct_answer: The building's owner and the site contractor
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המשטרה פתחה במצוד אחר בעל הבניין והקבלן שהיה אחראי לאתר.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “rubble” mean?
options: Broken pieces left after a building is destroyed
Official papers for a construction project
Equipment used to build scaffolding
A group of rescue workers
tasks.correct_answer: Broken pieces left after a building is destroyed
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המילה rubble פירושה שברי בטון וחומרים אחרים שנותרו לאחר קריסת מבנה.

tasks.prompt: Why did the collapse raise wider concerns in Kenya?
options: The building was the tallest in Africa.
Rescue teams refused to enter Eastleigh.
It happened during a national holiday.
It renewed questions about construction standards, planning and enforcement.
tasks.correct_answer: It renewed questions about construction standards, planning and enforcement.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: האירוע עורר שוב דאגה לגבי איכות הבנייה, עמידה בתקנות והיכולת לאכוף תכניות ובטיחות.

tasks.prompt: Give two details showing that the building was still under construction when it collapsed.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני פרטים מדויקים המעידים שהעבודות בבניין טרם הסתיימו.
expected_points: Scaffolding was still wrapped around the outside.
Dozens of builders were working on the upper floors.
The block was explicitly described as being under construction.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the collapse, the rescue situation and the police response in 2–3 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לכלול את הקריסה בניירובי, שני המחולצים וחמשת הנעדרים, וכן את החקירה או המצוד אחר האחראים.
expected_points: A 16- or 18-storey building under construction collapsed in Nairobi's Eastleigh area.
Two people were rescued alive and five were still missing.
Police began investigating the cause and searching for the owner and contractor.

tasks.prompt: Why did officials focus on paperwork and building regulations after the collapse? Use two facts from the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את הקשר בין חוסר האישורים, שאלות על בדיקת האתר והחשד לרשלנות או הפרת תקנות.
expected_points: Eleven shops had already opened on the lower floors.
The governor said the owners lacked the required paperwork for occupation.
The construction authority did not say whether the site had been inspected.
Police were examining possible negligence or building-rule violations.

tasks.prompt: Write a short factual news update about the rescue. Include the location, the number rescued and the number still missing.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב עדכון חדשותי קצר ומדויק ללא השערות, ולכלול מקום ושלושת הנתונים המבוקשים.
expected_points: Identifies Nairobi or Eastleigh as the location.
States that two people were rescued alive.
States that five people remained missing.
Uses a clear, neutral news style.
